title: Covariate-assisted graph matching
abstract: arXiv:2512.11761v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data integration often requires aligning datasets without unique identifiers; for network data this is commonly addressed through graph matching. Despite the widespread availability of node and edge covariates in many applications, most existing methods rely solely on the structural similarity between the two graphs, limiting their flexibility and robustness to non-identifiable matches and structural noise. In this article, we study the seeded graph matching problem, where a partial alignment for a set of nodes (seeds) is known, in the presence of informative node and edge covariates. We propose two covariate-assisted methods: a global approach based on a quadratic assignment problem (QAP), and a scalable local approach that leverages the neighborhood of the seeds. Both methods are based on a flexible conditional modeling framework that enables covariate integration using predictive models ranging from generalized linear models

translated_abstract: 数据集成通常需要在没有唯一标识符的情况下对齐数据集；对于网络数据，这通常通过图匹配来解决。尽管在许多应用中节点和边协变量广泛存在，但大多数现有方法仅依赖两个图之间的结构相似性，这限制了它们在不可识别匹配和结构噪声下的灵活性与鲁棒性。在本文中，我们研究了带种子的图匹配问题，即在已知一组节点（种子）部分对齐的情况下，同时利用信息丰富的节点和边协变量。我们提出了两种协变量辅助方法：一种基于二次分配问题（QAP）的全局方法，以及一种利用种子邻域的可扩展局部方法。两种方法都基于一个灵活的条件建模框架，能够使用从广义线性模型开始的各种预测模型来整合协变量。
tldr: 本文提出两种利用节点和边协变量信息的带种子图匹配方法——基于二次分配问题的全局方法和利用种子邻域的可扩展局部方法，显著提升了图匹配在结构噪声和不可识别匹配情形下的灵活性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two covariate-assisted seeded graph matching methods—a global approach based on quadratic assignment problems and a scalable local approach leveraging seed neighborhoods—to improve flexibility and robustness against non-identifiable matches and structural noise by incorporating node and edge covariates.
